question: Are some referral codes restricted to specific contracts? In particular regarding Distribution Reward support of Spark Savings Vaults V1 vs Spark Savings Vaults V2.
answer:
### Short answer
The Atlas does not appear to state whether *referral codes* are restricted to specific contracts (for example, Spark Savings Vaults V1 vs V2).

### What the Atlas does show
- There is a Distribution Reward primitive and Spark-specific Distribution Reward documents (policy/specs):  
  > "Docs. herein govern Distrib. Reward Primitive." — [Distribution Reward Primitive](/atlas/e632c38f-3e4e-4c7e-acfd-b6ec45a422e6)  
  > "Docs. herein contain all data Specs. Spark’s Inst. Distrib. Reward Primitive." — [Distribution Reward Primitive](/atlas/87916659-3b1e-4e65-8080-d6e1baab74e4)

- The Distribution Reward rate text ties rewards to a reward code:  
  > "Distrib. Reward rate is annualized all USDS sUSDS balances associated relevant Reward Code." — [Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759)

- Distribution Reward payments are tracked as Active Data and list the responsible party (Operational GovOps):  
  > "Distrib. Reward payments SparkLend Inst. Distrib. Reward Prim. are defined as Active Data. ... Responsible Party is Oper. GovOps." — [Distribution Reward Payments](/atlas/971d047b-4e7b-4545-9090-6d509e572aa0)

### Conclusion / next step
None of the returned Atlas documents include language about *referral codes* being restricted to particular on‑chain contracts or about different handling for Spark Savings Vaults V1 vs V2. If you need a definitive ruling (e.g., whether a given referral code may be used with a specific Vault contract), that is outside what the Atlas text here specifies — you should consult the responsible parties (Operational GovOps) or the facilitator/team that manages the Distribution Reward integration for Spark.
